name: cap
title: Cap
description: Start and stop screen recordings with Cap, search your recordings, and open your dashboard.
author: CapSoftware

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Cap Server URL
preferences.description: Custom or self-hosted Cap server URL (defaults to Cap Desktop's configured server or https://cap.so).

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Recording Mode
preferences.description: Recording mode used by Start Recording when no mode argument is selected.

preferences.name: defaultScreen
preferences.title: Default Screen Name Override
preferences.description: Optional exact display name to capture (leave empty to use Cap Desktop's saved target or the active display).

preferences.name: cameraDeviceId
preferences.title: Camera Device ID Override
preferences.description: Optional camera DeviceID override (leave empty to preserve the camera selected in Cap Desktop).

preferences.name: micLabel
preferences.title: Microphone Name Override
preferences.description: Optional microphone label override (leave empty to preserve the microphone selected in Cap Desktop).

preferences.name: systemAudio
preferences.title: Capture System Audio
preferences.description: Whether to capture system audio when starting a recording from Raycast.

preferences.name: recordingsDirectory
preferences.title: Recordings Directory
preferences.description: Optional custom local directory containing .cap recording bundles (defaults to Cap Desktop's configured recordings folder).

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Cap API Key / Token
preferences.description: Optional Cap CLI API key for searching cloud Caps (falls back to CAP_AGENT_TOKEN, CAP_API_KEY, or Cap Desktop login).

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Start a Cap screen recording using your saved Cap Desktop defaults or custom overrides.

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop Recording
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Stop the active Cap recording (Cap copies the shareable link to the clipboard automatically for Instant recordings).

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Open your Cap web dashboard in the default browser.

commands.name: search-caps
commands.title: Search Caps
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Search and browse your recent local and cloud Cap recordings, copy shareable links, or open them in Cap Editor.

commands.name: open-settings
commands.title: Open Cap Settings
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Open the Cap Desktop settings window.
